design: Hill ODE counterpart, 3^5=243 IC grid, t_end=40, dt=0.1; Boolean core reference: wg-ON fixed point exists (1,1,1,0,0) with basin 20/32
mechanism: wg-ON Boolean state (1,1,1,0,0) has ci=0; wg's only activator in the core is ci, so in the ODE wg production vanishes and linear decay erases the state. Discrete bistability is update-rule-supported, not ODE-supported, without self-activation.
threshold_reading: wg-ON reappears only for autoactivation >= 0.9 of full Hill strength; below 0.85 the continuous system has a single all-OFF attractor for all tested (K,n). Boolean bistability is therefore update-rule-supported: it survives continuous dynamics only with near-full-strength wg self-activation.
